name: Re-identification benchmark (2006)
description: A benchmark dataset and evaluation protocol for re-identification methods, validated using fuzzy clustering to assess matching performance across instances.
evaluation_method: mean average precision (mAP) and CMC (rank-k accuracy)
reputation: An early academic re-identification benchmark of historical interest; limited adoption compared to later, larger re-id datasets.
notes: Small, older dataset with legacy evaluation protocol; non-LLM benchmark. May not reflect performance on modern, large-scale re-id datasets and can suffer from limited diversity and potential biases.
